audience: employers who fill open shifts with freelancers on ZekerFlex

useCases.title: Find open shifts that still need workers
useCases.text: List the open shifts with their time, hourly rate, positions and status. Open one shift to see the people already scheduled on it.

useCases.title: Review approved timesheets and billable minutes
useCases.text: List the approved and paid timesheets, most recently approved first, with billable minutes, hourly rate and branch.

useCases.title: Check invoices received since a date
useCases.text: List the invoices issued to your organization, newest first. Give a date to see only the invoices from that date on.
